banner.title: spegel
banner.tagline: Lets every node pull an image layer from a peer that already holds it, falling back to the upstream registry on a miss.

explainer.title: Pull from the nearest node that has the layer

steps.title: Redirect
steps.text: containerd on each node is pointed at a local mirror through host config written into /etc/cri/conf.d/hosts.
steps.scene: a path bending through a node-shaped junction

steps.title: Locate
steps.text: Each node announces the layers it holds to its peers. A pull asks the peers which node has the digest.
steps.scene: several nodes lighting up around a shared index

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: A peer that holds the layer serves it from its own containerd content store, over HTTP, inside the cluster.
steps.scene: a layer block passing from one node to another

steps.title: Fall back
steps.text: A miss, or a timeout, sends the pull to the upstream registry. A missing peer never fails a pull.
steps.scene: a branch returning to the outer registry cloud
